description: This file contains tests and utility functions related to Triton kernel integration within the PyTorch Inductor backend. It includes kernel definitions, test cases for kernel compilation, execution, autotuning, and various edge cases involving Triton-accelerated kernels, buffer reuse, constants, and shape handling.

classes.name: KernelTests
classes.description: Test cases for Triton kernel functionalities integrated with PyTorch Inductor, including kernel compilation, execution, autotuning, and edge cases.

classes.name: KernelTests
classes.description: Test cases for Triton kernel functionalities integrated with PyTorch Inductor, including kernel compilation, execution, autotuning, and edge cases involving buffer reuse, constants, shape handling, and dependencies.

methods.description: Tests defining and launching a Triton kernel with a kernel parameter.

methods.description: Tests compilation and error handling of a malformed Triton kernel.

methods.description: Tests higher order Triton kernel functions with mutation and functional approaches.

methods.description: Tests conversion of Triton kernels into functional representations using torch.fx and custom API modes.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_mutation_type
methods.description: Validates correct mutation handling and autograd behavior when using Triton kernel mutations.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_with_views
methods.description: Tests Triton kernels operating on tensor views and resulting in correct output.

methods.description: Ensures Triton kernels avoid unnecessary buffer clones and clones are minimized.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_caching_duplicate

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_various_args

methods.description: Tests in-place mutation behavior with Triton kernels.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_multi_kernel
methods.description: Validates multiple Triton kernels dispatched in a single compiled call.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_constants

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_2d_autotune
methods.description: Tests 2D autotuning configurations for Triton kernels.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_tracing
methods.description: Tests Triton kernel call tracing and recompilation with torch.fx.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_native

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_matmul_tracking

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_strided_input

methods.name: test_layout_constraint_needs_fixed_stride_order
methods.description: Tests behavior with custom operators and fixed stride order constraints.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_strided_input_nonzero_offset

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_slice_and_view_input
methods.description: Tests Triton kernel on sliced and view tensors.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_fallback
methods.description: Tests fallback kernel invocation paths within Triton-compiled code.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_to_cpu
methods.description: Verifies kernels can operate on CPU tensor inputs (via trampoline) and produce correct results.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_out_of_order
methods.description: Checks kernel argument order flexibility.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_unbacked_shape_tensor

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_equal_to_1_float_arg

methods.description: Tests special keyword arguments with autotune configuration.

methods.name: test_triton_kernel_empty_autotune_config_dict
methods.description: Tests kernels with empty autotuning configurations.

methods.description: Tests kernel with explicitly specified parameters such as number of warps and stages, with autotune possibility.

methods.description: Checks handling of unsupported args during autotune.

methods.description: Tests on-device tensor memory address (TMA) usage with Triton kernels, including different TMA support APIs.
